findings.reason: The standalone original tiles contain no illustration. A concrete fundamental-domain picture materially separates horizontal fibre leaves from the transverse suspension direction, while the endpoint chain exposes why the displayed action gives inverse rather than forward monodromy. This is warranted explanatory diagram scope, despite the complete independent proof.
findings.action: Added a schematic fundamental-domain rectangle with horizontal slices and upward transverse flow, followed by the time-one and seam endpoint chain, in existing final Remarks.

correction: Added only explanatory prose and a fenced TikZ illustration after the existing Remarks paragraph. Original title, statement, Facts, proof, links and all frontmatter bytes remain identical.

diagram_math_checks.objects: L x [0,1], its slices L x {t}, and the quotient M under n.(x,t)=(f^n(x),t+n).
diagram_math_checks.check: The horizontal segments are explicitly whole-slice symbols, not an assertion that L is an interval or two-dimensional. Endpoints t=0,1 match the fundamental domain in proof step 1.2; the fibre foliation is the images of slices by Statement 2 and steps 1.1–1.4.

diagram_math_checks.objects: The upward arrow is the positive t vector field on L x R.
diagram_math_checks.check: Its t component is 1 and its L component is zero; it is transverse to tangent spaces of slices. D(f^n,t+n) fixes this field, so the arrow represents the descended transverse flow in step 1.5, not a leafwise direction.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Time-one transport T:L x {0} -> L x {1}; seam map S:L x {1} -> L x {0}.
diagram_math_checks.check: T(x,0)=(x,1). Applying action element -1 gives S(x,1)=(f^{-1}(x),0), so the dashed seam relates precisely these equivalent representatives. The composite S o T acts on the fibre identified with L as f^{-1}; all domains and codomains agree with step 1.5.

diagram_math_checks.objects: q:M -> S^1, q([x,t])=t mod 1, stated in the caption.
diagram_math_checks.check: Changing representative by (f^n(x),t+n) leaves t mod 1 unchanged; t increases in the arrow direction and endpoints project to the same base point. This is exactly step 1.4. The figure makes no new classification or bare-manifold claim.
All proof text is unchanged and establishes the results independently of the illustration.
